name: Extract invoice data from email PDF attachments into Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Extract invoice data from email PDF attachments into Google Sheets

### Who's it for
Freelancers, small businesses and bookkeepers who receive supplier invoices by email and copy the key fields into a spreadsheet by hand.

### How it works
1. The **Email Trigger (IMAP)** watches a mailbox (Gmail, Outlook, Fastmail or any IMAP server) for unread emails.
2. A **Code** node keeps only PDF attachments, optionally from allowed sender domains, and creates one item per PDF.
3. **Extract from File** reads the text layer of each PDF.
4. A second **Code** node finds the vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, currency and total with layout-tolerant rules (US and European number formats). Rows with a missing field are marked `needs review`.
5. Each invoice is appended as one row to **Google Sheets**.

### Setup
1. Open the **Config** node: set your spreadsheet ID, sheet name, default currency and, if you want, a comma-separated list of allowed sender domains.
2. Create a sheet tab with this header row: `received_at, from, subject, file_name, vendor, invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, currency, total, status`.
3. Connect your IMAP and Google Sheets credentials. For Gmail, use an app password.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
n8n (Cloud or self-hosted), an IMAP mailbox and a Google account. PDFs need a text layer. Scanned images need an OCR step first.

### Customization tips
Add patterns for your suppliers in **Parse invoice fields**, send `needs review` rows to Slack, or replace the parser with an AI extraction node.

Questions: LaborX (https://laborx.com/freelancers/users/id475124)

## 1. Receive invoice emails
New unread emails arrive from your mailbox. Only PDF attachments are kept, one item per file.

## 2. Read and parse the PDF
The text layer is extracted, then vendor, number, dates, currency and total are detected.

## 3. Log to Google Sheets
One row per invoice. Incomplete rows are flagged for review.
